correctness.rationale: The graph is fixed by an explicit standard Pappus edge set. The verifier enumerates all 2597 nonempty independent sets, constructs 1293 disjoint Hasse-cover pairs, and checks acyclicity over all 11430 covers by complete topological sorting. The only critical cells are one in dimension 0 and ten in dimension 4, which implies a wedge of ten 4-spheres. An independent mod-2 boundary computation gives reduced Betti rank 10 only in degree 4 and Euler characteristic 11. Risk: the conclusion uses the standard discrete-Morse theorem relating an acyclic matching to a homotopy-equivalent CW complex; no unverified computational shortcut is used.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical cubic symmetric graph and the Levi graph of the classical Pappus configuration, while incidence-graph theory makes its independence complex a natural topological object rather than an arbitrary slice. The exact homotopy type supplies a concrete nontrivial benchmark for a graph class where general theorems give only a suspension/Alexander-dual description. The result determines all homotopy and homology consequences of this complex at once. Risk: it is still a single finite example, so its value is as an exact canonical benchmark rather than as a family theorem.
